role.roleTitle: Customer Operations Manager, Subscription Billing Platform

evidence.text: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.

Resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections during those runs; the provider settlement outage of spring 2025 was the largest, and its record sits in the operations incident tracker under my name.

Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.
Took engineering and finance changes into production in the pre-run window before each run, with the change log marking my reconciliation checks separately from engineering's deployment checks.
Reported completion and error rates to finance after each run and kept the billing runbook current, revising it after the settlement outage and after each proration rule change.
Wrote the post-run notes and the incident notes, recording the platform's known limitations around mid-cycle proration and the conditions handed to whoever held the pager next.
